---
title: "Urban pollination networks with stochastic block models"
---

<br>

Material of my 3-hour course at the school [**Biodiversité urbaine : enjeux et modélisation**](https://urbanbiodiv.sciencesconf.org/) (Institut Henri Poincaré, Paris, 25–27 November 2026): analysis of urban pollination networks with stochastic block models (SBM, colSBM) and network comparison.

Running example: **Baldock et al. (2019)**, *Nature Ecology & Evolution* 3: 363–373. Plant–pollinator networks in 4 UK cities × 9 land uses.
